Name: Drink Soup
Author: sevengeese
Description:
Changes soups from foods to drinks, so you no longer have to crunch your soup! Also makes it easier in the Skull Cavern, as you can get buffs from one food and one drink at a time.

[b]22 July 2024[/b] Updated the format to match with the Content Patcher update for 1.6! Sorry it took so long!
Also fixed an issue in that in the previous version I forgot to make trout soup a drink too.
Moss soup appears to already be a drink in game, but let me know if I got that wrong so I can add that soup to this mod too.

[b]10 October 2024[/b] so... I recently had stew for the first time and realized I went way overboard in how many soups I thought were drinkable. Now only the ones that I think would be liquid enough are drink. That is: Parsnip Soup, Pumpkin Soup, Pale Broth, and Algae Soup. Last I checked, Moss Soup is already a drink in the game itself.

Downloads.Description: Removed the "chunkier" soups from being drinkable.
